description: Multiband saturator: the input is split into bands, each band is saturated on its own, and the bands are summed back together

params.text: Sets how hard each band is saturated
Switches the saturation to higher-quality processing, at the cost of CPU
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the drive CV input
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the tone CV input
Sets how many bands the input is split into before each one is saturated

inputs.text: Modulates the drive amount, after its attenuverter
Modulates the tone control, after its attenuverter
The signal fed into the saturator

outputs.text: The summed output of every saturated band
